sources.snippet: Any-to-Any model with 2B parameters, built with Transformers. Download, explore files and run it on Hugging Face.

sources.title: LFM3-Omni-2B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: ← Back to Omni Models LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI's first omni model: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video, and audio, and answers in text, speech, or interleaved text and speech. It is built for on-device use, where one model replaces a separate ASR model, vision-language model, LLM, and TTS model.

sources.title: LFM3-Omni-2B: First Omni Model That Speaks, Benchmarks - orcarouter.ai
sources.snippet: Liquid AI's LFM3-Omni-2B takes text, image, video and audio and returns 24 kHz speech. What the model card proves and what the leak got wrong.

sources.title: lfm3-omni - ollama.com
sources.snippet: LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI's first omni-modal model in the LFM3 family: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video and audio, and answers in text and speech. It is built for on-device use: one model replaces a separate ASR model, vision-language model, LLM and TTS model. Any input, text or speech output: ask about a photo by voice, transcribe or translate speech, chat out ...

sources.title: Introducing LFM3: Every Modality for Specialized Intelligence
sources.snippet: LFM3 is Liquid AI's new open-weight model family: 2B-class text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models built to fine-tune and run fast on any device.
